more_info.overview: Erythritol is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Produced by fermentation of carbohydrates with suitable food-grade yeasts. The erythritol is then purified and dried.
more_info.side_effects:
High food-use exposure estimates exceeded the limit.
Human studies establish dose-related diarrhoea; repeated diarrhoea may disturb fluid and electrolyte balance.
